source.name: Tab must leave a datepicker input for the next field, and a click must still show the calendar
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/43202) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

events.detail: Clean browser contexts; user-selected static source snapshot
Reproduce task and independent pointer functional baseline
Expected state did not occur after action
Rank source candidates from selector/name evidence
NVIDIA Nemotron proposes bounded edits via Nebius
Validate allowlist, hashes, unique preimages and change bounds in isolated copy
Validate static JavaScript syntax and HTML structure
Same frozen journey, fresh browser context
Deterministic task + functional + oracle + regression gate
Verified only for the tested journey and conditions

journey.title: Tab out of the departure date to the passengers field
journey.goal: Tab moves focus from the date field to the next field, as in any form

functionalJourney.title: Change the passengers with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Editing another field and saving submits the saved departure date

guards.title: Escape still closes the calendar
guards.goal: With the calendar open, Escape closes it and Tab then reaches the passengers field

guards.title: Clicking the date field still shows the calendar
guards.goal: A pointer user who clicks the departure date sees the month and can pick a day

plan.root_cause: The datepicker component's initialization causes the Vanilla Calendar Pro library to attach a keydown listener to the departure input that prevents the Tab keypress, blocking focus movement to the next field.
plan.repair_strategy: Wrap the departure input in a div with class 'form-adorn' so the datepicker positions the calendar relative to the div rather than the input. This prevents VCP from attaching the problematic keydown listener to the input, allowing normal Tab behavior.

edits.before:
<label class="form-label" for="departure">Departure date</label>
    <input class="form-control mb-3" id="departure" name="departure" value="2026-10-22" data-bs-toggle="datepicker" autocomplete="off">

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key will move focus from the departure date field to the passengers field as expected, restoring logical tab order in the form.
functional_risks: Calendar positioning may shift slightly due to the wrapper div, though the form-adorn class is intended for this purpose.
Label association remains intact via the input's id attribute.
Regression guards for Escape (calendar close) and click (calendar open) should remain functional as the input still triggers the datepicker.
verification_requirements: Pressing Tab from the departure field must focus the passengers field.
The calendar must still open when the departure field receives focus.
Pressing Escape must close the calendar if open.
Clicking the departure field must still show the calendar.
